title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your hands, about 2 minutes, any day this week (not urgent): switch on the start check you said yes to. At the PC or through Chrome Remote Desktop: open the Claude app, the Code tab, start a new session in the ledger-local folder, paste this one line and send it: install the gate hook, and add FoldCraft and ast-grep to the licence list as your pick A of 15 Nov. If Claude asks to allow a change to the project's settings, press Allow. It worked when Claude answers that both are done and committed. Then tap Done here. (Added 16 Nov 06:50: the licence list's line for FoldCraft and ast-grep, both MIT, also needs a turn you start.)
sections.recommendation: Done when convenient: saves about US$10 a day on quiet days. Only a session you start yourself may change the project's settings, so the hourly runs cannot do it for you.
